info.name: Phase 1 - User, Branch & Auth (Dev)
info.description: Covers only the User, Branch, and Auth endpoints touched in Phase 1/1.5. Run folders top to bottom - later requests depend on variables set by earlier ones (tokens, ids). No Purchase/Sale/Inventory/Batch/Transfer/GST/Product/Vendor/Customer endpoints are included.

exec: pm.test('No password field in response', function () {

request.description: Saves superAdminToken and superAdminId for use by every SUPER_ADMIN request below.

Despite the route name, this only creates the Branch (it does not create a branch admin). Real schema fields: name, code, phones (array), nested address object. Response is wrapped in data.branch.{...} (Update Branch below returns fields flat at data.{...} instead - a pre-existing inconsistency, not something this collection changes). code must match ^[A-Z0-9]{2,10}$ (no hyphens) - this is now enforced on create too, not just update. Saves branchId.

item.name: Create Second Test Branch (for role-change test)

request.description: A second branch with no existing BRANCH_ADMIN, needed to test promoting STAFF to BRANCH_ADMIN later (promoting into a branch that already has an admin is rejected with 409).
Hyphenated codes (the old dummy-data style) are now rejected on create, not just update. Expects 400 'Code must be 2-10 characters (uppercase letters and numbers only)'.
SUPER_ADMIN can fetch any branch, active or deactivated. BRANCH_ADMIN/STAFF can only fetch their own assigned branch (see Authorization Tests folder).

item.name: Get All Branches (list, active only - default)

request.description: Any authenticated role can call this (not SUPER_ADMIN-restricted). Excludes deactivated branches by default.

item.name: Get All Branches (include inactive - SUPER_ADMIN only)

request.description: New: includeInactive=true only takes effect for a SUPER_ADMIN caller - BRANCH_ADMIN/STAFF always get active-only regardless. This is the only way to discover a deactivated branch's id via listing.
This route is already SUPER_ADMIN-only at the router level. Unlike /branch/list, each returned branch here does include the isActive field.
Returns { totalBranches, activeBranches, inactiveBranches }.
Response fields are flat at data.{...} here, unlike Create Branch's data.branch.{...} wrapper.
This is Branch's soft-delete/'Delete Branch' mechanism - there is no separate hard/soft-delete endpoint. See folder 7 for the full deactivation-blocks-assignment test flow.
Run this right after Deactivate Branch so later requests in this collection are not affected by an inactive test branch.

formdata.description: Select a .jpg/.png/.webp file under 5MB before sending

request.description: Any 'role' sent in the body is ignored - this endpoint always creates a BRANCH_ADMIN. branchId is now fully validated: required, valid ObjectId, must exist, must be active.
Well-formed ObjectId that does not correspond to any real branch. Expects 404 'Branch not found' - proves a valid ObjectId shape alone is not enough.

item.name: Create STAFF - Invalid Branch ID Format (Deny)

request.description: Expects 400 'Invalid branch ID'. This validation did not exist at all before this round for create-staff.
Single-user read, added this round - previously there was no way to fetch one user by id at all (only the full list).

isActive query param is new this round - enable it (true/false) to test 'get active users' vs 'get deactivated users' explicitly. Omitted (default) returns all non-deleted users regardless of active status.
If branchId is included here and differs from the current one, it is now validated (exists + active) just like create - see folder 7.
Confirm by re-running '4. Auth - Branch Admin & Staff Login' > Login BRANCH_ADMIN with this new password.

This is User's soft-delete/'Delete User' mechanism - there is no separate hard/soft-delete endpoint. A deactivated user gets 403 'User account is inactive' on next login (confirmed live). This endpoint blocks deactivating the LAST remaining active SUPER_ADMIN - only test on STAFF/BRANCH_ADMIN.

request.description: Uses branchId2 (no existing admin) - promoting into a branch that already has a BRANCH_ADMIN is rejected with 409. Promoting into a deactivated or non-existent branch is rejected too - see folder 7.

item.name: Expired Token (Deny) - manual/optional
item.description: Postman cannot forge a validly-signed expired token without the server's JWT_SECRET. Paste one generated with server access if you want to run this; expect 401 either way (also 401 as-is with the placeholder, since it's not a valid signature).
